name: dumbbell biceps curl with overhead extension on stability ball
description: Sitting on a stability ball, you curl a dumbbell and then press it overhead into an extension. It works both arms muscles and trunk balance.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball holding a dumbbell.
Curl the dumbbell up with your elbow at your side.
Raise it overhead, lifting it with both hands.
Lower it behind your head for a triceps extension.
Extend, return to the front, and repeat.
